newsitem.title: USA: USWC conventional gasoline firms with supply drop.
newsitem.headline: USWC conventional gasoline firms with supply drop.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast conventional unleaded gasoline advanced in light Wednesday trade, after sharply lower inventories were reported by American Petroleum Institute (API) Tuesday, traders said.
No deals were reported at midday, but conventional unleaded was talked between 77.50 and 78.50 cents in Los Angeles, a one cent increase from late Tuesday levels.
Bullish inventory data firmed the market, with West Coast gasoline inventories down 1.2 million barrels last week to 25.7 million.
CARB-grade diesel in L.A. rose one cent Wednesday, traders said.
Trade was slow to get going as traders returned from an industry conference.
